dedupe_keys.name: ontario land ambulance response time standard data response time plans and performance by municipality and dispatch centre

description: This dataset publishes the legislated land ambulance response time reports for every upper-tier municipality and land ambulance communication service in Ontario, Canada, as an indicator of paramedic service performance. The Government of Ontario posts it on its open data catalogue, also listed on the federal open.canada.ca portal. Tables include paramedic services response time plans and performance, the response time plans and performance of the Central Ambulance Communication Centres that dispatch ambulances, average response times and call volumes, and population estimates, land area, population density and average response times for each municipality. Response targets follow the Canadian Triage and Acuity Scale and sudden cardiac arrest categories set in the municipalities' plans. Coverage is the whole province by municipality and dispatch centre, with the catalogue record updated in August 2026. Files are free CSV downloads in English and French under the Open Government Licence - Ontario. Caveats: figures are annual aggregates reported by the services themselves, targets differ between municipalities, and there are no incident-level records or station locations. Simulation uses: calibrating ambulance coverage and response time models against observed performance, comparing rural and urban service levels, and setting targets for location-allocation studies. Related records: England fire incident response times (data-england-fire-incident-response-times) and FDNY EMS incident dispatch data (data-nyc-fdny-ems-incident-dispatch) give comparable response measures.
